questions.question: When the elders of Israel came to a prophet to inquire of the LORD, how did God answer them?

answers.text: He would not be consulted by them
He would answer them in a dream

questions.question: On the day God chose Israel in Egypt, what did He swear to do for them?

answers.text: Bring them out into a land He picked for them
Give them the best land in all of Egypt
Make them the rulers over all of Egypt

questions.question: After the children of Israel kept rejecting His ways in the wilderness, what did God swear to do to them?
Where did God say the whole house of Israel would one day serve Him in their land?
